visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit clothing retail store. A woman with long reddish-brown hair in a striped shirt holds a tan skirt, looking toward a man in a light blue t-shirt who is gesturing. To the left, a woman in a lavender shirt stands behind a counter with a laptop. Clothing racks with various garments are visible in the background. (2) A full-screen graphic transition appears with a bright yellow background and colorful stylized text in Traditional Chinese and English. (3) Inside a restaurant or cafe service area. A man with blonde-dyed hair wearing a white polo shirt with a logo stands next to a woman in a black and white uniform holding a white cloth. He is speaking while gesturing with his hands. The background features a wooden counter and kitchen-style shelving.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 這群人. [Subtitle]: 不好意思 / Excuse me. (2) [Subtitle]: 重點是你... / But the point is you... (3) [Subtitle]: 我現在有你的把柄喔 / I know your secret now. (4) [Subtitle]: 先生 / Sir. (5) [Subtitle]: 幹嘛啦? / What? (6) [Subtitle]: 想問那件有沒有 size? / wondering if you have this in other sizes. (7) [Subtitle]: 喔我們的 size 都是一樣的 / We sell one-size products. (8) [Subtitle]: 而且我們都在架上 / And what you see on the shelf is everything we have. (9) [Subtitle]: 沒有庫存 / We don't have any extras in the stock. (10) [Variety]: 唸兩句就做到明天. [Slogan]: I'll Quit Tomorrow. (11) [Subtitle]: 我希望下次我在點餐的時候呢 / I hope that next time when I'm taking an order... (12) [Subtitle]: 然後你可以稍微就是偷聽一下 / you can stand around and listen. (13) [Subtitle]: 好我知道 / Ok, go it. (14) [Subtitle]: 我就做到明天 / I'll quit tomorrow. (15) [Subtitle]: 蛤? / Huh? (16) [Subtitle]: 我完全站在你這邊角度 / I'm standing in your shoes. (17) [Subtitle]: 我能理解你 / I totally understand. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以我就做到明天了 / So I'll quit tomorrow. (19) [Subtitle]: 對不起木星 / Excuse me, Jupiter. (20) [Subtitle]: 我剛剛的話 / What I just said. (21) [Subtitle]: 店長謝謝你真的 / Keelong, thank you so much. (22) [Subtitle]: 我現在就走 / I leave now.
